## Game 01: Subsetting Lists

```{r game01}
campus = jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")
names(campus) #shows the named elements within a list(or vector) or the cols in a data frame

fsb = campus$Farmer #equivalent campus[['Farmer']] by name or campus[[5]] by position
fsb$code

fsb[[8]]$'2'$sections

sec_floor = fsb[[8]]$'2'

sec_floor_rooms = sec_floor[[3]]
sec_floor_rooms[6,2]
```



##Reading the Excel File

```{r occupations}
occupation = readxl::read_excel(
  path = "../data/occupation.xlsx",
  sheet = 5, # sheet = "Table 1.4"
  skip = 1
)
# - when you subset in R drops these specific things
# give that they are three, I put them in a vector
# notice the "," after the parenthesis
# nothing after the comma which means all columns
#instead of that space --> 1.7
occupation = occupation[-c(32,33,34),]
```

## Read JSON Data

```{r read_json}
json_url = "https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json?$limit=100"
crashes_json = jsonlite::fromJSON(json_url)
dplyr::glimpse(crashes_json)

```
